import math

enum Command
    Gen
    Pcheck
    Hamming
    Simplex
    Repetition
    Parity
    Rm
    Cyclic
    Dual
    Extend
    Puncture
    Shorten
    Augment
    Expurgate
    Permute
    Directsum
    Uuv
    Product
    List
    Delete
    Show
    Info
    Systematic
    Weights
    Covering
    Burst
    Trellis
    Stdarray
    Equal
    Encode
    Syndrome
    Decode
    Bounded
    Coset
    Erasure
    Interleave
    Crc
    Crccheck
    Factor
    Macwilliams
    Bounds

class Format(Command kind, string name, string types, int minimum, int maximum)

Format[] formats()
    return [
        Format(Command.Gen, "GEN", "NV", 2, 25), Format(Command.Pcheck, "PCHECK", "NV", 2, 25),
        Format(Command.Hamming, "HAMMING", "NI", 2, 2), Format(Command.Simplex, "SIMPLEX", "NI", 2, 2),
        Format(Command.Repetition, "REPETITION", "NI", 2, 2), Format(Command.Parity, "PARITY", "NI", 2, 2),
        Format(Command.Rm, "RM", "NII", 3, 3), Format(Command.Cyclic, "CYCLIC", "NIV", 3, 3),
        Format(Command.Dual, "DUAL", "NA", 2, 2), Format(Command.Extend, "EXTEND", "NA", 2, 2),
        Format(Command.Puncture, "PUNCTURE", "NAI", 3, 3), Format(Command.Shorten, "SHORTEN", "NAI", 3, 3),
        Format(Command.Augment, "AUGMENT", "NA", 2, 2), Format(Command.Expurgate, "EXPURGATE", "NA", 2, 2),
        Format(Command.Permute, "PERMUTE", "NAI", 3, 26), Format(Command.Directsum, "DIRECTSUM", "NAB", 3, 3),
        Format(Command.Uuv, "UUV", "NAB", 3, 3), Format(Command.Product, "PRODUCT", "NAB", 3, 3),
        Format(Command.List, "LIST", "", 0, 0), Format(Command.Delete, "DELETE", "A", 1, 1),
        Format(Command.Show, "SHOW", "A", 1, 1), Format(Command.Info, "INFO", "A", 1, 1),
        Format(Command.Systematic, "SYSTEMATIC", "A", 1, 1), Format(Command.Weights, "WEIGHTS", "A", 1, 1),
        Format(Command.Covering, "COVERING", "A", 1, 1), Format(Command.Burst, "BURST", "A", 1, 1),
        Format(Command.Trellis, "TRELLIS", "A", 1, 1), Format(Command.Stdarray, "STDARRAY", "A", 1, 1),
        Format(Command.Equal, "EQUAL", "AB", 2, 2), Format(Command.Encode, "ENCODE", "AV", 2, 2),
        Format(Command.Syndrome, "SYNDROME", "AV", 2, 2), Format(Command.Decode, "DECODE", "AV", 2, 2),
        Format(Command.Bounded, "BOUNDED", "AIV", 3, 3), Format(Command.Coset, "COSET", "AV", 2, 2),
        Format(Command.Erasure, "ERASURE", "AX", 2, 2), Format(Command.Interleave, "INTERLEAVE", "AIIV", 4, 11),
        Format(Command.Crc, "CRC", "VV", 2, 2), Format(Command.Crccheck, "CRCCHECK", "VV", 2, 2),
        Format(Command.Factor, "FACTOR", "I", 1, 1), Format(Command.Macwilliams, "MACWILLIAMS", "II", 2, 26),
        Format(Command.Bounds, "BOUNDS", "II", 2, 2),
    ]

bool letter(int point)
    return 65 <= point <= 90 or 97 <= point <= 122

bool digit(int point)
    return 48 <= point <= 57

bool valid_word(string text, string kind)
    if #text == 0
        return false
    int[] points := text.codepoints()
    if kind == "N" or kind == "A" or kind == "B"
        if #text > 8 or not letter(points[0])
            return false
        for point := points[]
            if not letter(point) and not digit(point)
                return false
    elif kind == "I"
        if #text > 4 or (#text > 1 and text[0] == "0")
            return false
        for point := points[]
            if not digit(point)
                return false
    else
        if #text > 30
            return false
        for: character_index < #text
            unit := text[character_index]
            if unit != "0" and unit != "1" and not (kind == "X" and unit == "?")
                return false
    return true

int64 power2(int exponent)
    return int64(1) << int64(exponent)

int64 mask(int size)
    return power2(size) - 1

int64 bit(int size, int column)
    return power2(size - column - 1)

int64 parse_bits(string text)
    int64 result := 0
    for: character_index < #text
        unit := text[character_index]
        result = result * 2 + (if unit == "1" then 1 else 0)
    return result

int weight(int64 value)
    result := 0
    while value != 0
        value = value AND (value - 1)
        result += 1
    return result

int bit_length(int64 value)
    result := 0
    while value != 0
        value = value >> 1
        result += 1
    return result

string bit_text(int64 value, int size)
    result := ""
    for: column < size
        result += if (value AND bit(size, column)) == 0 then "0" else "1"
    return result

string yes(bool value)
    return if value then "yes" else "no"

string numbers(const int[] values)
    return [for value := values[] then string(value)].join(" ")

int[] parsed(const string[] words)
    return [for word := words[] then int(word)]

int index_of<T>(const T[] values, T wanted)
    for index := values.indices()[]
        if values[index] == wanted
            return int(index)
    return -1

class Division(int64 quotient, int64 remainder)

Division divide(int64 value, int64 divisor)
    int64 quotient := 0
    while value != 0 and bit_length(value) >= bit_length(divisor)
        shift := bit_length(value) - bit_length(divisor)
        quotient = quotient XOR power2(shift)
        value = value XOR (divisor << int64(shift))
    return Division(quotient, value)

int64[] basis(const int64[] source, int size)
    int64[] pivots := array(nat(size), fill = 0)
    int64[] result := []
    for original := source[]
        row := original
        for: column < size
            if (row AND bit(size, column)) == 0
                continue
            if pivots[column] != 0
                row = row XOR pivots[column]
            else
                pivots[column] = row
                result = result.append(original)
                break
    return result

class Echelon(int64[] rows, int[] columns)

Echelon rref(const int64[] source, int size)
    rows := source
    int[] columns := []
    for: column < size
        rank := int(#columns)
        found := rank
        while found < int(#rows) and (rows[found] AND bit(size, column)) == 0
            found += 1
        if found == int(#rows)
            continue
        temporary := rows[rank]
        rows[rank] = rows[found]
        rows[found] = temporary
        for index := rows.indices()[]
            if int(index) != rank and (rows[index] AND bit(size, column)) != 0
                rows[index] = rows[index] XOR rows[rank]
        columns = columns.append(column)
    return Echelon(rows[0:<#columns], columns)

int64[] null_space(const int64[] source, int size)
    reduced := rref(source, size)
    int64[] result := []
    for: column < size
        if index_of(reduced.columns, column) >= 0
            continue
        row := bit(size, column)
        for index := reduced.rows.indices()[]
            if (reduced.rows[index] AND bit(size, column)) != 0
                row = row OR bit(size, reduced.columns[index])
        result = result.append(row)
    return result

int64[] span(const int64[] rows)
    int64[] result := [0]
    for row := rows[]
        result = result.concat([for value := result[] then value XOR row])
    return result

int64[] reed_muller(int order, int variables)
    if order == 0
        return [mask(2 ^ variables)]
    half := 2 ^ (variables - 1)
    first := reed_muller(math.min(order, variables - 1), variables - 1)
    rows := [for row := first[] then (row << int64(half)) OR row]
    return rows.concat(reed_muller(order - 1, variables - 1))

class Code(int size, int64[] generator, int64[] parity, int64 | none polynomial := none)
    int dimension()
        return int(#generator)
    string encoder()
        match polynomial
            int64
                return "polynomial"
            none
                return "matrix"

void | error check_dimension(int size, int dimension)
    if not (1 <= dimension <= 12 and 1 <= size - dimension <= 12)
        return error("bad dimension {size} {dimension}")
    return void

Code | error make_code(int size, const int64[] generator, int64[] | none parity := none, int64 | none polynomial := none)
    try check_dimension(size, int(#generator))
    match parity
        int64[] rows
            return Code(size, generator, rows, polynomial)
        none
            return Code(size, generator, null_space(generator, size), polynomial)

int64 encode(const Code code, int64 message)
    match code.polynomial
        int64 divisor
            shifted := message << int64(#code.parity)
            return shifted OR divide(shifted, divisor).remainder
        none
            int64 result := 0
            for index := code.generator.indices()[]
                if (message AND bit(code.dimension(), int(index))) != 0
                    result = result XOR code.generator[index]
            return result

int64 syndrome(const Code code, int64 word)
    int64 result := 0
    for row := code.parity[]
        result = (result << 1) OR int64(weight(row AND word) % 2)
    return result

int64 message_of(const Code code, int64 word)
    for: message < power2(code.dimension())
        if encode(code, message) == word
            return message
    return 0

int64[] leaders(const Code code)
    int64[] result := array(nat(power2(int(#code.parity))), fill = -1)
    result[0] = 0
    found := 1
    for: 1 <= size <= code.size
        word := mask(size)
        while word < power2(code.size)
            state := syndrome(code, word)
            if result[state] == -1
                result[state] = word
                found += 1
                if found == int(#result)
                    return result
            lowest := word AND -word
            next := word + lowest
            word = next OR (((next XOR word) >> 2) / lowest)
    return result

class Decoded(int64 word, int64 message, int64 error_pattern)

Decoded decode(const Code code, int64 received, const int64[] errors)
    pattern := errors[syndrome(code, received)]
    word := received XOR pattern
    return Decoded(word, message_of(code, word), pattern)

string decoded_text(const Code code, Decoded value)
    return "codeword {bit_text(value.word, code.size)} message {bit_text(value.message, code.dimension())} error {bit_text(value.error_pattern, code.size)} weight {weight(value.error_pattern)}"

int burst_correction(const Code code)
    seen := array(nat(power2(int(#code.parity))), fill = false)
    seen[0] = true
    for: 1 <= size <= code.size
        variants := if size == 1 then int64(1) else power2(size - 2)
        for: 0 <= offset <= code.size - size
            for: middle < variants
                word := if size == 1 then int64(1) else power2(size - 1) OR (middle << 1) OR 1
                state := syndrome(code, word << int64(offset))
                if seen[state]
                    return size - 1
                seen[state] = true
    return 0

Code | error construct(Command command, const string[] args, const Code[] sources)
    if command == Command.Gen or command == Command.Pcheck
        size := int(#args[1])
        for word := args[1:][]
            if int(#word) != size
                return error("bad length")
        rows := basis([for word := args[1:][] then parse_bits(word)], size)
        if command == Command.Pcheck
            return make_code(size, null_space(rows, size), rows)
        return make_code(size, rows)
    if command == Command.Hamming or command == Command.Simplex
        order := int(args[1])
        if not (2 <= order <= 4)
            return error("bad parameter")
        size := int(mask(order))
        int64[] rows := array(nat(order), fill = 0)
        for: index < order
            for: 1 <= column <= size
                rows[index] = (rows[index] << 1) OR ((int64(column) >> int64(order - index - 1)) AND 1)
        if command == Command.Hamming
            return make_code(size, null_space(rows, size), rows)
        return make_code(size, rows)
    if command == Command.Repetition or command == Command.Parity
        size := int(args[1])
        if not (2 <= size <= 24)
            return error("bad parameter")
        int64[] rows := if command == Command.Repetition then [mask(size)] else [for column := (0:<int(size - 1))[] then bit(size, column) OR 1]
        return make_code(size, rows)
    if command == Command.Rm
        order := int(args[1])
        variables := int(args[2])
        if not (1 <= variables <= 4) or order > variables
            return error("bad parameter")
        return make_code(2 ^ variables, reed_muller(order, variables))
    if command == Command.Cyclic
        size := int(args[1])
        degree := int(#args[2]) - 1
        if not (2 <= size <= 24) or args[2][0] != "1" or not (1 <= degree < size)
            return error("bad parameter")
        polynomial := parse_bits(args[2])
        if divide(power2(size) OR 1, polynomial).remainder != 0
            return error("not a divisor")
        dimension := size - degree
        rows := [for index := (0:<int(dimension))[] then polynomial << int64(dimension - index - 1)]
        int64[] parity := array(nat(degree), fill = 0)
        for: column < size
            residue := divide(bit(size, column), polynomial).remainder
            for: index < degree
                parity[index] = (parity[index] << 1) OR ((residue >> int64(degree - index - 1)) AND 1)
        return make_code(size, rows, parity, polynomial)
    source := sources[0]
    size := source.size
    int64[] rows := []
    if command == Command.Dual
        return make_code(size, source.parity, source.generator)
    if command == Command.Extend
        rows = [for row := source.generator[] then (row << 1) OR int64(weight(row) % 2)]
        return make_code(size + 1, rows)
    if command == Command.Puncture or command == Command.Shorten or command == Command.Expurgate
        expurgating := command == Command.Expurgate
        int position := if expurgating then 0 else int(args[2])
        if not expurgating and not (1 <= position <= size)
            return error("bad position")
        removed := -1
        if command != Command.Puncture
            for index := source.generator.indices()[]
                row := source.generator[index]
                selected := if expurgating then weight(row) % 2 != 0 else (row AND bit(size, position - 1)) != 0
                if selected
                    removed = int(index)
                    break
        for index := source.generator.indices()[]
            if int(index) == removed
                continue
            row := source.generator[index]
            selected := if expurgating then weight(row) % 2 != 0 else (row AND bit(size, position - 1)) != 0
            if removed >= 0 and selected
                row = row XOR source.generator[removed]
            if not expurgating
                low := size - position
                row = ((row >> int64(low + 1)) << int64(low)) OR (row AND mask(low))
            rows = rows.append(row)
        if not expurgating
            size -= 1
        if command == Command.Puncture
            rows = basis(rows, size)
        return make_code(size, rows)
    if command == Command.Augment
        return make_code(size, basis(source.generator.append(mask(size)), size))
    if command == Command.Permute
        permutation := parsed(args[2:])
        if permutation.sorted() != [for column := (1:<(int(size) + 1))[] then column]
            return error("bad permutation")
        for original := source.generator[]
            int64 row := 0
            for column := permutation[]
                row = (row << 1) OR (if (original AND bit(size, column - 1)) != 0 then 1 else 0)
            rows = rows.append(row)
        return make_code(size, rows)
    other := sources[1]
    if command == Command.Uuv and size != other.size
        return error("bad length")
    dimension := if command == Command.Product then source.dimension() * other.dimension() else source.dimension() + other.dimension()
    combined_size := if command == Command.Product then size * other.size else size + other.size
    try check_dimension(combined_size, dimension)
    if command == Command.Product
        for left := source.generator[]
            for right := other.generator[]
                int64 row := 0
                for: column < size
                    row = (row << int64(other.size)) OR (if (left AND bit(size, column)) != 0 then right else int64(0))
                rows = rows.append(row)
    else
        rows = [for row := source.generator[] then (row << int64(other.size)) OR (if command == Command.Uuv then row else int64(0))]
        rows = rows.concat(other.generator)
    return make_code(combined_size, rows)

int[][] binomials()
    int[][] result := array(25, fill = array(25, fill = 0))
    for: row < 25
        result[row][0] = 1
        for: 1 <= column <= row
            result[row][column] = result[row - 1][column - 1] + result[row - 1][column]
    return result

int choose(const int[][] table, int size, int selected)
    return if selected < 0 or selected > size then 0 else table[size][selected]

int volume(const int[][] table, int size, int radius)
    return table[size][0:radius].sum()

int greatest_common_divisor(int left, int right)
    while right != 0
        left, right = right, left % right
    return left

string fraction_text(int numerator, int denominator)
    common := greatest_common_divisor(math.abs(numerator), denominator)
    numerator /= common
    denominator /= common
    return if denominator == 1 then string(numerator) else "{numerator}/{denominator}"

int[] distribution(const int64[] words, int size, int64 offset := 0)
    result := array(nat(size + 1), fill = 0)
    for word := words[]
        result[weight(word XOR offset)] += 1
    return result

string weight_items(const int[] counts)
    string[] items := []
    for index := counts.indices()[]
        if counts[index] != 0
            items = items.append("{index}:{counts[index]}")
    return items.join(" ")

string[] systematic(string name, const Code code)
    size := code.size
    dimension := code.dimension()
    rows := code.generator
    permutation := [for column := (1:<(int(size) + 1))[] then column]
    for: pivot < dimension
        column := pivot
        while true
            present := false
            for: pivot <= row < dimension
                if (rows[row] AND bit(size, column)) != 0
                    present = true
                    break
            if present
                break
            column += 1
        if column != pivot
            for index := rows.indices()[]
                if ((rows[index] AND bit(size, pivot)) != 0) != ((rows[index] AND bit(size, column)) != 0)
                    rows[index] = rows[index] XOR bit(size, pivot) XOR bit(size, column)
            temporary := permutation[pivot]
            permutation[pivot] = permutation[column]
            permutation[column] = temporary
        found := pivot
        while (rows[found] AND bit(size, pivot)) == 0
            found += 1
        temporary := rows[pivot]
        rows[pivot] = rows[found]
        rows[found] = temporary
        for: row < dimension
            if row != pivot and (rows[row] AND bit(size, pivot)) != 0
                rows[row] = rows[row] XOR rows[pivot]
    output := ["systematic {name} perm " + numbers(permutation)]
    output = output.concat([for row := rows[] then "G " + bit_text(row, size)])
    for: column < size - dimension
        int64 row := 0
        for source := rows[]
            row = (row << 1) OR (if (source AND bit(size, dimension + column)) != 0 then 1 else 0)
        row = (row << int64(size - dimension)) OR bit(size - dimension, column)
        output = output.append("H " + bit_text(row, size))
    return output

string[] | error inspect_code(Command command, const string[] args, const Code[] sources, const int[][] table)
    code := sources[0]
    name := args[0]
    size := code.size
    dimension := code.dimension()
    if command == Command.Show
        output := ["code {name} n {size} k {dimension} encoder {code.encoder()}"]
        match code.polynomial
            int64 polynomial
                quotient := divide(power2(size) OR 1, polynomial).quotient
                output = output.append("poly g " + bit_text(polynomial, size - dimension + 1) + " h " + bit_text(quotient, dimension + 1))
            none
                void
        output = output.concat([for row := code.generator[] then "G " + bit_text(row, size)])
        return output.concat([for row := code.parity[] then "H " + bit_text(row, size)])
    if command == Command.Systematic
        return systematic(name, code)
    if command == Command.Equal
        other := sources[1]
        if size != other.size
            return ["equal {name} {args[1]} no lengths {size} {other.size}"]
        common := dimension + other.dimension() - int(#basis(code.generator.concat(other.generator), size))
        return ["equal {name} {args[1]} " + yes(dimension == other.dimension() == common) + " intersection {common}"]
    if command == Command.Trellis
        int[] profile := []
        for: 0 <= column <= size
            left := [for row := code.generator[] then row >> int64(size - column)]
            right := [for row := code.generator[] then row AND mask(size - column)]
            profile = profile.append(int(#basis(left, column)) + int(#basis(right, size - column)) - dimension)
        return ["trellis {name} profile " + numbers(profile) + " max {profile.max()}"]
    if command == Command.Covering
        counts := distribution(leaders(code), size)
        radius := size
        while counts[radius] == 0
            radius -= 1
        items := [for index := (0:<(int(radius) + 1))[] then "{index}:{counts[index]}"]
        return ["covering {name} radius {radius} leaders " + items.join(" ")]
    if command == Command.Stdarray and (size - dimension > 6 or dimension > 4)
        return error("too large")
    words := span(code.generator)
    if command == Command.Info
        distance := [for word := words[1:][] then weight(word)].min()
        correction := (distance - 1) / 2
        cyclic := true
        for row := code.generator[]
            rotated := ((row << 1) AND mask(size)) OR (row >> int64(size - 1))
            if syndrome(code, rotated) != 0
                cyclic = false
                break
        polynomial := "no"
        if cyclic
            first := words[1:].min()
            polynomial = bit_text(first, bit_length(first))
        perfect := volume(table, size, correction) == 2 ^ (size - dimension)
        return ["info {name} n {size} k {dimension} rate " + fraction_text(dimension, size) + " d {distance} t {correction} perfect " + yes(perfect) + " mds " + yes(distance == size - dimension + 1) + " cyclic {polynomial}"]
    if command == Command.Weights
        primal := distribution(words, size)
        dual := distribution(span(code.parity), size)
        orthogonal := true
        for left := code.generator[]
            for right := code.generator[]
                if weight(left AND right) % 2 != 0
                    orthogonal = false
        return [
            "weights {name} " + weight_items(primal),
            "dual {name} " + weight_items(dual),
            "duality {name} self-orthogonal " + yes(orthogonal) + " self-dual " + yes(orthogonal and size == 2 * dimension) + " formally-self-dual " + yes(primal == dual),
        ]
    if command == Command.Burst
        detection := [for word := words[1:][] then bit_length(word) - bit_length(word AND -word)].min()
        return ["burst {name} detect {detection} correct {burst_correction(code)}"]
    errors := leaders(code)
    keys := [for pattern := errors[] then int64(weight(pattern)) * power2(size) + pattern]
    output := ["stdarray {name} rows {#errors} columns {#words}"]
    words = words.sorted()
    for key := keys.sorted()[]
        pattern := key % power2(size)
        state := index_of(errors, pattern)
        row := [for word := words[] then bit_text(pattern XOR word, size)]
        output = output.append(bit_text(int64(state), size - dimension) + ": " + row.join(" "))
    return output

string[] | error encode_report(Command command, const string[] args, const Code code)
    name := args[0]
    size := code.size
    dimension := code.dimension()
    if command == Command.Interleave
        messages := args[3:]
        for message := messages[]
            if int(#message) != dimension
                return error("bad length")
        start := int(args[1])
        length := int(args[2])
        depth := int(#messages)
        if start < 1 or length < 1 or start + length - 1 > depth * size
            return error("bad burst")
        encoded := [for message := messages[] then encode(code, parse_bits(message))]
        received := encoded
        sent_text := ""
        received_text := ""
        for: column < size
            for: row < depth
                sent := (encoded[row] AND bit(size, column)) != 0
                position := column * depth + row + 1
                flipped := start <= position < start + length
                sent_text += if sent then "1" else "0"
                received_text += if sent != flipped then "1" else "0"
                if flipped
                    received[row] = received[row] XOR bit(size, column)
        output := ["interleave {name} depth {depth} burst {start} {length}", "sent {sent_text}", "recv {received_text}"]
        errors := leaders(code)
        correct := 0
        for: row < depth
            result := decode(code, received[row], errors)
            success := result.message == parse_bits(messages[row])
            if success
                correct += 1
            status := if success then "ok" else "wrong"
            output = output.append("row {row + 1} errors {weight(received[row] XOR encoded[row])} corrected {weight(result.error_pattern)} message " + bit_text(result.message, dimension) + " {status}")
        return output.append("result ok {correct} wrong {depth - correct}")
    text := if command == Command.Bounded then args[2] else args[1]
    expected := if command == Command.Encode then dimension else size
    if int(#text) != expected
        return error("bad length")
    if command == Command.Encode
        return ["encode {name} message {text} codeword " + bit_text(encode(code, parse_bits(text)), size)]
    if command == Command.Erasure
        erased := 0
        int64 known := 0
        int64 value := 0
        for: character_index < #text
            unit := text[character_index]
            known = (known << 1) OR (if unit == "?" then 0 else 1)
            value = (value << 1) OR (if unit == "1" then 1 else 0)
            if unit == "?"
                erased += 1
        int64[] candidates := []
        for word := span(code.generator)[]
            if (word AND known) == value
                candidates = candidates.append(word)
        output := "erasure {name} erased {erased} candidates {#candidates}"
        if #candidates == 1
            output += " codeword " + bit_text(candidates[0], size) + " message " + bit_text(message_of(code, candidates[0]), dimension)
        return [output]
    received := parse_bits(text)
    state := syndrome(code, received)
    if command == Command.Syndrome
        return ["syndrome {name} " + bit_text(state, size - dimension) + " codeword " + yes(state == 0)]
    errors := leaders(code)
    if command == Command.Coset
        return ["coset {name} syndrome " + bit_text(state, size - dimension) + " leader " + bit_text(errors[state], size) + " weights " + weight_items(distribution(span(code.generator), size, received))]
    result := decode(code, received, errors)
    if command == Command.Bounded
        if weight(result.error_pattern) > int(args[1])
            return ["bounded {name} fail weight {weight(result.error_pattern)}"]
        return ["bounded {name} " + decoded_text(code, result)]
    return ["decode {name} " + decoded_text(code, result)]

int krawtchouk(const int[][] table, int size, int index, int argument)
    int[] terms := []
    for: 0 <= selected <= index
        sign := if selected % 2 == 0 then 1 else -1
        terms = terms.append(sign * choose(table, argument, selected) * choose(table, size - argument, index - selected))
    return terms.sum()

string[] | error independent_report(Command command, const string[] args, const int[][] table)
    if command == Command.Crc or command == Command.Crccheck
        degree := int(#args[0]) - 1
        if args[0][0] != "1" or not (1 <= degree <= 16)
            return error("bad parameter")
        polynomial := parse_bits(args[0])
        word := parse_bits(args[1])
        if command == Command.Crc
            if int(#args[1]) + degree > 30
                return error("bad length")
            residue := bit_text(divide(word << int64(degree), polynomial).remainder, degree)
            return ["crc remainder {residue} frame {args[1]}{residue}"]
        residue := divide(word, polynomial).remainder
        status := if residue == 0 then "ok" else "error"
        return ["crccheck {status} remainder " + bit_text(residue, degree)]
    size := int(args[0])
    if command == Command.Factor
        if not (1 <= size <= 24)
            return error("bad parameter")
        remaining := power2(size) OR 1
        int64 factor := 3
        string[] factors := []
        divisors := 1
        while 2 * (bit_length(factor) - 1) <= bit_length(remaining) - 1
            exponent := 0
            while divide(remaining, factor).remainder == 0
                remaining = divide(remaining, factor).quotient
                exponent += 1
            if exponent != 0
                factors = factors.append(bit_text(factor, bit_length(factor)) + "^{exponent}")
                divisors *= exponent + 1
            factor += 2
        if remaining != 1
            factors = factors.append(bit_text(remaining, bit_length(remaining)) + "^1")
            divisors *= 2
        return ["factor {size} " + factors.join(" ") + " divisors {divisors}"]
    if command == Command.Macwilliams
        if not (1 <= size <= 24)
            return error("bad parameter")
        if int(#args) != size + 2
            return error("bad length")
        counts := parsed(args[1:])
        if counts[0] != 1
            return error("bad parameter")
        total := counts.sum()
        feasible := weight(int64(total)) == 1
        string[] dual := []
        for: 0 <= index <= size
            numerator := [for argument := (0:<(int(size) + 1))[] then counts[argument] * krawtchouk(table, size, index, argument)].sum()
            if numerator < 0 or numerator % total != 0
                feasible = false
            dual = dual.append(fraction_text(numerator, total))
        return ["macwilliams n {size} size {total}", "dual " + dual.join(" "), "feasible " + yes(feasible)]
    distance := int(args[1])
    if not (1 <= distance <= size <= 24)
        return error("bad parameter")
    hamming := 0
    griesmer := 0
    ball := volume(table, size, (distance - 1) / 2)
    required := 0
    for: 0 <= dimension <= size
        if (2 ^ dimension) * ball <= 2 ^ size
            hamming = dimension
        if dimension > 0
            divisor := 2 ^ (dimension - 1)
            required += (distance + divisor - 1) / divisor
            if required <= size
                griesmer = dimension
    return ["bounds n {size} d {distance} singleton {size - distance + 1} hamming {hamming} griesmer {griesmer}"]

class Laboratory()
    codes := map<string, Code>()
    table := binomials()
    forms := formats()

Code | error code_named(const map<string, Code> registry, string name)
    match registry.get(name)
        Code code
            return code
        none
            return error("no code {name}")

string[] | error execute(Laboratory &laboratory, string line)
    words := line.split(" ")
    selected := -1
    for index := laboratory.forms.indices()[]
        if laboratory.forms[index].name == words[0]
            selected = int(index)
            break
    if selected == -1
        return error("unknown command {words[0]}")
    form := laboratory.forms[selected]
    args := words[1:]
    if not (form.minimum <= int(#args) <= form.maximum)
        return error("bad arguments")
    for index := args.indices()[]
        kind := form.types[math.min(int(index), int(#form.types) - 1)]
        if not valid_word(args[index], kind)
            return error("bad arguments")
    Code[] sources := []
    for: index < #form.types
        if form.types[index] == "A" or form.types[index] == "B"
            source := try code_named(laboratory.codes, args[index])
            sources = sources.append(source)
    if selected < 18
        code := try construct(form.kind, args, sources)
        action := if laboratory.codes.has(args[0]) then "redefined" else "defined"
        .laboratory.codes.set(args[0], code)
        return ["{action} {args[0]} n {code.size} k {code.dimension()}"]
    if form.kind == Command.List
        output := ["codes {laboratory.codes.size()}"]
        for name := laboratory.codes.keys().sorted()[]
            code := try code_named(laboratory.codes, name)
            output = output.append("{name} n {code.size} k {code.dimension()} encoder {code.encoder()}")
        return output
    if form.kind == Command.Delete
        .laboratory.codes.remove(args[0])
        return ["deleted {args[0]}"]
    if selected >= 36
        return independent_report(form.kind, args, laboratory.table)
    if selected <= 28
        return inspect_code(form.kind, args, sources, laboratory.table)
    return encode_report(form.kind, args, sources[0])

code_laboratory := Laboratory()
int command_count
scan(&command_count)
for: command_index < command_count
    string command_line
    scan(&command_line)
    match execute(&code_laboratory, command_line)
        string[] output
            for row := output[]
                println(row)
        error problem
            println("error: " + problem.message)
